a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: Space.

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED, and inside the <label>: the whole row is the target, not just the 16px box.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Keeps the label in the DOM but out of sight — for a table selection column.

props.name: description
props.description: Second line under the label, for the consequence of ticking it.

props.name: checked / defaultChecked
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. For the third state, the one between, use indeterminate.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Some, not all — the "select all" of a list with part of it selected. The box shows a dash in the checked colour, and a screen reader hears "mixed" (the input's indeterminate property, set by the component). The app controls it: a click checks or clears the box, and the app says whether it stays indeterminate. Web only.

props.name: size
props.description: The system's size step. It is not the HTML size attribute, which does not exist on a checkbox anyway.

props.name: variant
props.description: pill puts a capsule around the box and the label (the --fill-2 fill, weight 600): the whole capsule is the target, 44 tall (--target-min, box 24), or 36 with size="sm" or "md" (--control-h-md, box 20). The focus ring goes around the capsule.

props.name: tone
props.description: With variant="pill", a checked capsule turns to done: the capsule green at 18%, the label and the box in --success-400.
